messages.subject: Support for Samejima CRM?
parts: Is there any possibility of adding Samejima's continuous response model as a built-in model for mirt?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Support for Samejima CRM?
parts:
Not likely. From what I recall it has a radically different estimation approach which isn't compatible with the Bock & Aiken style estimation via a quadrature built E table. Could be wrong, but I don't see how it could work in the current framework.

Phil
